Saturday and Sunday B Rides

Tucson, AZ · Road

When
Saturdays and Sundays, 7:30 amEvery Saturday and Sunday, 7:30 am. The start place changes: Starbucks on E 22nd St, Pub 1922 in Sahuarita, 49er Country Club, Bashas on E Sunrise, or a lot in Vail. The club's October 2026 calendar lists a ride every weekend day from Oct 3 to Oct 31, 30 to 54 miles.
Starts at
Changes by week. October 2026: Starbucks (9451 E 22nd St, Tucson), Pub 1922 (15920 S Rancho Sahuarita Blvd, Sahuarita), 49er Country Club (12000 E Tanque Verde Rd, Tucson), Bashas (6900 E Sunrise, Tucson), vacant lot at 13005 E Benson Hwy, Vail Map ↗
Pace
Level B, 15 to 17 mph, in the club's own rating. 964 to 2,950 feet of climbing depending on the route.

How we know

Cactus Cycling Club's schedule page lists a 7:30 am ride on every Saturday and Sunday from Oct 3 to Oct 31, 2026 (fetched Sept 30, 2026).

Hosted by
Cactus Cycling ClubClub
Cost
Free for one ride a year on a Trial membership
Kind of ride
Road

For visitors

Guests sign up for a free Trial membership (one ride a year), sign the waiver and register for the ride on the club's site before they roll. The club's page says you must be a member to register. A and C riders can join at their own pace. The club cancels for weather by email, so check your email before you leave. Bring more water than you think. Check the start place for the weekend you want: it moves around the Tucson area.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:30 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–17 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Saturday and Sunday B Rides group ride

Saturday and Sunday B Rides is a road group ride in Tucson, AZ. It rolls saturdays and Sundays at 7:30 am from Changes by week. October 2026: Starbucks (9451 E 22nd St, Tucson), Pub 1922 (15920 S Rancho Sahuarita Blvd, Sahuarita), 49er Country Club (12000 E Tanque Verde Rd, Tucson), Bashas (6900 E Sunrise, Tucson), vacant lot at 13005 E Benson Hwy, Vail.

Cactus Cycling Club runs a B-level ride every Saturday and Sunday morning from a different start each week. October 2026 includes San Xavier from Sahuarita, Corona de Tucson, Madera Canyon, Sabino Canyon, Colossal Cave and Marsh Station, from 30 to 54 miles. Some Sundays end with brunch or a club meeting.
